maya (AE): Team, Orionova just dropped an RFI. Top asks: POC acceptance criteria, committed monthly reserved pricing bands, overage rates, data residency options, and short KMS/HSM compatibility statement. Need quick sync to compile responses.
josh (SE): I can own the POC acceptance criteria and perf targets. They listed 220 qps gen and 600 rpm embeddings. Suggest 14-day pilot with targets: embed p95 < 400ms, gen end-to-end p95 < 800ms, error rate < 0.5%.
kevin (Solutions Eng): For 220 qps sustained recommend Dedicated with 2x A100 equiv or equivalent spot of Dedicated cluster; reserve price estimate $22k-$34k/month depending on region and term. Recommend 20% pilot discount off the low end. Overage: $0.14 per gen-token-equivalent; $0.0011 per embed.
maya (AE): Good. They want clear wording on rollback/failover behavior if Dedicated experiences an outage during pilot.
josh (SE): Add: auto-failover to compatible hosted model variant in nearest region with best-effort latency; we can also configure synchronous fallback to a smaller model to preserve availability. Include notice about potential latency increase.
rachel (Security Eng): KMS/HSM wording: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys for Private and Dedicated deployments via KMIP-compatible HSMs and major cloud KMS providers. Hosted API offers BYOK via envelope encryption with partner HSM integrations. Key usage audit events are available." Also: "SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 reports available under NDA; annual third-party penetration tests."
maya (AE): Data residency note?
rachel (Security Eng): We can isolate pilot workloads to NA or EU regions for hosted; Private/on-prem for strict residency or air-gapped needs. Copy for RFI: "Region-restricted hosted deployments (NA, EU) available; Private/on-prem deployments supported for customers requiring full data locality."
kevin (Solutions Eng): Add a short preflight checklist for their infra ops: 
- Allow outbound HTTPS to region endpoint
- Whitelist our egress IPs if needed
- Validate token access: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
- TLS check: openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.ai:443 -brief
maya (AE): Contracts asked if we can provide a refundable trial deposit model. Any standard?
kevin (Solutions Eng): Standard is one-month reserved fee held as a deposit and refundable on completion if pilot acceptance met. We can propose that.
maya (AE): Legal? Can we provide DPA and SOW template to include with the reply?
legal-bot: DPA and SOW templates attached to shared Drive; please request redlines via legal channel.
josh (SE): Draft capability matrix rows to include: Data Residency, KMS/HSM, Observability (per-route latency & token accounting), Rollout & Failover, Quantization support (INT8/4-bit on Dedicated).
maya (AE): Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/orionova-rfi/ (cap matrix + SOW + DPA). Ill compile and aim to send a first-pass response by EOD. RFI-bot: Intake logged and assigned to maya (AE) 6 due date 2026-04-05.
maya (AE): Thanks all :thumbsup: Ill post the compiled RFI packet here when ready."
